quotes.text: It was so much fun to host our #VA02 Congressional App Challenge showcase last night...! This year we had nine impressive applications designed by students from across our district! Congratulations to Andy and Aarav on being named this year's winners for your app VisuAI. Their app utilizes AI to describe images to assist those who are visually impaired – GREAT WORK!!

I remain heartbroken by images coming out of Southern California. While wildfires are not entirely avoidable, we can act to prevent them from destroying entire communities through proper forest management. Proud to be an original cosponsor of @RepWesterman's Fix Our Forests Act!

Today, the House will vote on this bill which would:
✅ Reform environmental reviews to better manage forests
✅ Bolster hazardous fuel reduction in high-risk areas
✅ Deploy new technology, such as AI and 5G, to respond to wildfires quicker
✅ Increase collaboration between Federal, State, Tribal, and private land managers to protect communities

It's past time all levels of government come together and take action to mitigate these devastating disasters from occurring in the future!

Artificial intelligence will define the next century of economic growth, national security, and global competitiveness. We must lead in developing responsible, transparent AI systems that reflect American values, not the interests of foreign adversaries. The AI for America Act ensures that the United States remains the world’s innovation leader by setting clear goals, strengthening research infrastructure, and removing outdated barriers to safe adoption.

Right now, federal agencies lack a unified strategy for integrating AI into mission-critical functions. This bill ensures the federal government takes a coordinated, strategic approach across agencies, strengthens public-private partnerships, and protects Americans from bias, cybersecurity threats, or misuse of data.
They have data centers under the ocean floor. We can’t ban all data centers.
